first_10_minutes: Identify the per-second income label shown on the weapon you currently hold before evaluating any offer.
When a trade panel appears, compare both weapon panels and their visible income labels before accepting or declining.
Treat boxed weapon rewards as possible collection upgrades, but verify the live UI because the official media does not document probabilities or exact controls.
core_loop: Read its displayed per-second income signal.
Compare it with the weapon shown on the other side of a trade.
Accept only after the visible offer matches what you intend to receive; otherwise decline.
Repeat while seeking stronger displayed income output.
progression_path: Start by learning where the live interface shows weapon income.
Prefer clearly verifiable improvements over visually flashy but unverified offers.
Build a personal record of observed weapon names and rates because no official value list was found.
common_mistakes: Accepting before checking both sides of the offer.
Assuming a weapon's appearance proves its income value.
Trusting unofficial codes, value tables, rarity names, or crate odds that are not documented by the creator.
Confusing place ID 124993558819856 with universe ID 10625493331.
